using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.FileSystem;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using OpenRA.Test;
using OpenRA.Widgets;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic.Installation
{
	public class DownloadPackageLogicMirrorListTest
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task MirrorListDownload_Success_Path_InvokesDownloadUrl()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = TestModData.Create();
			var download = new ModContent.ModDownload
			{
				MirrorList = "https://example.com/mirrors.txt",
				URL = "https://fallback.com/package.zip"
			};

			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			mockHttpClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync("https://example.com/mirrors.txt", default))
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new StringContent("https://mirror1.com/package.zip\nhttps://mirror2.com/package.zip")
				});

			var httpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<Func<HttpClient>>();
			httpClientFactoryMock.Setup(f => f()).Returns(mockHttpClient.Object);

			// Patch HttpClientFactory.Create to return our mock (test seam)
			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var downloadUrlsCalled = new List<string>();
				Action onSuccess = () => { };

				var widget = MockWidget.Create("PACKAGE_DOWNLOAD_PANEL");
				var logic = new DownloadPackageLogic(widget, modData, download, onSuccess);

				// Replace DownloadUrl with test spy
				var downloadUrlMethod = typeof(DownloadPackageLogic).GetMethod("DownloadUrl", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
				downloadUrlMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Action<string>), (string url) => downloadUrlsCalled.Add(url))!;

				// Act
				await Task.Delay(100); // Allow Task.Run to execute

				// Assert
				Assert.Single(downloadUrlsCalled);
				Assert.Contains("https://mirror1.com/package.zip", downloadUrlsCalled[0]);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task MirrorListDownload_Failure_FallsBackToPrimaryUrl()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = TestModData.Create();
			var download = new ModContent.ModDownload
			{
				MirrorList = "https://example.com/mirrors.txt",
				URL = "https://fallback.com/package.zip"
			};

			var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			mockHttpClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), default))
				.ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException("Mirror fetch failed"));

			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockHttpClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var downloadUrlsCalled = new List<string>();
				Action onSuccess = () => { };

				var widget = MockWidget.Create("PACKAGE_DOWNLOAD_PANEL");
				var logic = new DownloadPackageLogic(widget, modData, download, onSuccess);

				// Spy on DownloadUrl
				var downloadUrlMethod = typeof(DownloadPackageLogic).GetMethod("DownloadUrl", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
				downloadUrlMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Action<string>), (string url) => downloadUrlsCalled.Add(url))!;

				// Act
				await Task.Delay(100);

				// Assert - should call DownloadUrl with primary URL
				Assert.Single(downloadUrlsCalled);
				Assert.Equal("https://fallback.com/package.zip", downloadUrlsCalled[0]);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = () => new HttpClient();
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public void NoMirrorList_DirectlyCallsDownloadUrlWithPrimaryUrl()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = TestModData.Create();
			var download = new ModContent.ModDownload
			{
				URL = "https://direct.com/package.zip"
				// No MirrorList
			};

			var downloadUrlsCalled = new List<string>();
			Action onSuccess = () => { };

			var widget = MockWidget.Create("PACKAGE_DOWNLOAD_PANEL");
			var logic = new DownloadPackageLogic(widget, modData, download, onSuccess);

			// Spy on DownloadUrl
			var downloadUrlMethod = typeof(DownloadPackageLogic).GetMethod("DownloadUrl", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
			downloadUrlMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Action<string>), (string url) => downloadUrlsCalled.Add(url))!;

			// Act
			logic.ShowDownloadDialog();

			// Assert
			Assert.Single(downloadUrlsCalled);
			Assert.Equal("https://direct.com/package.zip", downloadUrlsCalled[0]);
		}
	}
}

				MirrorList = "https://example.com/mirrors.txt"

			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}
	}
